name: Corporate Action Event Reference 4 Choice
definition: Choice between a corporate action identification or a corporate action official identification.

LinkedOfficialCorporateActionEventIdenti.name: Linked Official Corporate Action Event Identification
LinkedOfficialCorporateActionEventIdenti.definition: Official and unique reference assigned by the official central body/ entity within each market at the beginning of a corporate action event.

LinkedCorporateActionIdentification.name: Linked Corporate Action Identification
LinkedCorporateActionIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a related corporate action event.
